result.summary: Expands the RPC help text for preciousblock. Clarifies that the call has no effect if the block has less work than the active chain tip, and that it only breaks ties among chains with equal work rather than pinning a chain against more-work forks.
result.problem: The current help text for preciousblock is terse and omits key operational limits, leading callers to mistakenly assume that a successful return guarantees a tip change or pins a chain.
evidence: PR description notes confusion arising during work on mining RPCs: 'leaves out cases that confuse users, including me (see discussion in #35300)'
result.scope_notes: Trivial documentation-only change to RPC help strings (+3 lines).
result.card: Clarifies the help text for the preciousblock RPC. It explains that the call has no effect if the block has less work than the active chain tip and only resolves ties between equal-work chains rather than pinning the chain. This prevents user confusion identified during mining RPC development in PR 35300. It is a documentation-only update without code changes.

risk.why: Only changes RPC help text and modifies no runtime node behavior.
